plugins.description: Superpowers (Jesse Vincent, MIT) 7.0.1: a skills library for disciplined work: brainstorming, writing and executing plans, test-driven development, systematic debugging, code review, git worktrees, subagent-driven development. Its SessionStart hook adds the using-superpowers skill to every session. The built-in kit superpowers brings the same skills as plain skills for Claude, Codex and OpenCode, without the hook.
